timeflow.event: Medical evacuation team lead names herself Кадзама Рицу (Kusa female chief medic). Shiki orders continuous existing unidentified IV infusion and patient transfer, hold spare reserve dose conditional on deterioration; Ritsu and Tiyo under guard locate single backup reservoir in wagon2 case. They aseptically extract only a small sealed aliquot for urgent clinical analysis and retain majority of dose with patient, do not give it preemptively. Ritsu says airway/ventilation support may be needed, oxygen alone insufficient if respiratory muscle output fails. Transport frame placed on equipped emergency stretcher. Patient conscious, SpO2~94% on oxygen, tachycardia to124 during movement, no further recognized collapse. Tiyo under guard of two Kusa shinobi accompanies patient on evacuation. By 18:11 they have departed customs yard toward Kusa hospital, not yet arrived.

Shiki tells Ritsu he has deliberately cut/motor-disrupted hostile kunoichi limb nerves, believes life not under threat and treatment possible. Ritsu checks awake woman, breathing/pulse stable and sensation preserved, but no purposeful limb control. NPC kunoichi hears everything, says 'Возможна…' and protests 'Я здесь.' Ritsu cautions restoration cannot be promised, applies nonrestrictive protective limb fixation to prevent injury, leaves under local medic guard for second medical transport. No automatic regeneration, no permanent paralysis prognosis fixed.

Shiki orders concealed third wagon hatch M-4/032 opened. Jun (right rib injury but commanding independently) assigns two Kusa border men; they remove false flooring, inspect for obvious wires/seals, see none, work three sprung metal lock bolts with small tool. Open narrow metal cover, cold dry air escapes. Inside compact cold chamber a metal sealed cylinder ~80cm, holder with 3 tag slots one empty, two med-nickel cards: 'М-4 / 032 / РЕЦИПИЕНТ' and 'М-4 / 032 / КОНТРОЛЬНЫЙ ОБРАЗЕЦ'. Direct physical association of third wagon hatch with M4-series registry now seen; contents of sealed cylinder unknown; exact connection to Inaba no definitive source confirmed.

When hatch raised, small metallic click; dark lacquer over inside of lid exposes red seal-script markings linked to bolt/lock mechanism, and chakra travels toward fuuinjutsu layer under 80cm cylinder. First Kusa border guard sleeve catches a latch; second border guard tries to pull him from reach, Jun shouts retreat. Shiki from ~3m visually senses/recognizes fast charging thermal destruction seal due elite knowledge/observation; possible pressure burst in enclosed chamber, no actual blast yet. Seal is already triggered, approx 1 second until closing. Two Kusa guards in immediate danger and contents may be destroyed. User must decide any intervention; no auto Shiki movement or defense.
